options.name: doorway
options.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one premium homepage hero illustration for InScene, an experiential scenario learning platform for schools and police training. Landscape 4:3 framing. Mature editorial illustration, stylized matte paper sculptural forms, soft diffused light and restrained layered depth, not photorealistic. Blue #3268FF, deep navy #13283C, pale blue #EAF0FF, off-white and muted teal. No people, characters, hands, faces, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI screenshots or glossy sci-fi. A single coherent art-directed scene, ample breathing room, focal objects in central 70% for crops, rich yet uncluttered. Subject: A striking freestanding cobalt doorway, slightly open, on a curved pale platform. Inside the doorway is a miniature believable Indian school/community courtyard with a shaded tree, bench, steps and noticeboard with no writing. The exterior is abstract light space, the inside a warm nuanced real-world environment. A blue path flows from foreground across the threshold. Strong visual contrast between possibility outside and a meaningful situation inside. Sophisticated architectural illustration, no people.
